description.zh:
1. DataSourceId和EmrInstanceId必须指定一项作为输入，否则报错。
2. 如果上述2个参数均指定，则优先使用EmrInstanceId入参。
3. 如果DataSourceId所指定的数据源，为自建Hadoop集群，则直接报错。
description.en:
1. Either DataSourceId or EmrInstanceId must be specified as input, otherwise an error will occur.
2. If both of the above parameters are specified, EmrInstanceId will be used preferentially.
3. If the data source specified by DataSourceId is a self-built Hadoop cluster, an error will occur directly.

title.zh: 检测hadoop外部数据源网络联通性

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb check-hadoop-net-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxx --emr-instance-id c-xxx --data-source-id 126 --region cn-hangzhou
